gemini.title: Registered Battlefields
gemini.abstract: Authoritative boundary polygons for the 47 historic battlefields registered in England. Each feature represents one registered battlefield and includes its National Heritage List for England identifier, official name, registration dates, mapped area, location reference and link to the official designation record. The register supports recognition, conservation and consideration of nationally important battlefield sites in planning decisions.
gemini.lineage: Published by Historic England as part of the National Heritage List for England (NHLE). Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: listentry
columns.description: Unique seven-digit National Heritage List for England entry number, such as 1000000.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Official registered battlefield name, usually including the battle year, such as Edgehill 1642.

columns.name: regdate
columns.description: Date the battlefield was first entered on the Register.

columns.name: amenddate
columns.description: Date the registration record was most recently amended; empty where no amendment is recorded.

columns.name: capturescale
columns.description: Map scale used to capture the battlefield boundary, such as 1:10000 or 1:25000.

columns.name: hyperlink
columns.description: URL of the battlefield's official Historic England List entry.

columns.name: area_ha
columns.description: Area enclosed by the registered battlefield boundary, measured in hectares.

columns.name: ngr
columns.description: Ordnance Survey National Grid Reference used to locate the battlefield.

columns.name: easting
columns.description: British National Grid easting in metres for the battlefield's reference location.

columns.name: northing
columns.description: British National Grid northing in metres for the battlefield's reference location.

columns.name: objectid
columns.description: ArcGIS source-system row identifier; not a persistent heritage asset identifier.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Multipolygon boundary of the registered battlefield in British National Grid coordinates.
